caveats: Distributions regenerated in-script by importing scripts/opt_sweep/f16.py and f17.py machinery verbatim (paper sims: BS VIX-flat vol, r=0.06, no smile, no txn costs/slippage, margin proxy = max wing width - credit; per-unit-margin returns; F16 41 monthly entries, F17 231 weekly, 2011-07..2023-04). DD probabilities via iid bootstrap (seed 42, 20000 one-year paths, n_cyc=round(entries/yr)); iid ignores vol clustering so real DD odds are worse -- the constrained f values are upper bounds. Small tails dominate: F16 worst -30.6% of margin (COVID), F17 one measured -100% week (Budget 2016-02-29) makes f=1 in-sample ruin (P(r<=-100%)=0.4% of weeks) and caps weekly Kelly at 0.35. F16 f*>1 means levered margin -- infeasible jointly with the book under the CONTRACT 1.5x gross cap. Feeds the H60-VRP design brief; no promotion.
